- **What it measures:** Two independent idle-power channels—GPU die power read from the hwmon `power1_average` sysfs node, and CPU package power read from the Intel RAPL energy counter (`energy_uj`)—plus a snapshot of ancillary state (core voltage, S/M clocks, junction temp, fan RPM, GPU/mem busy %, PCIe ASPM/clkpm, DPMS, DPM level) so the power numbers can be correlated with the system's actual operating point.
